parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Let your eyes close gently. <short pause> Feel the weight of your body sinking into the bed beneath you. <short pause> Your head rests on the pillow. Your shoulders soften. <short pause> Breathe in slowly through your nose... <short pause> and out through your mouth. <short pause> Again, in through your nose... <short pause> and out, letting the day fall away.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: This has been a day like any other day... full of moments large and small. <short pause> Some of those moments you are proud of. Others you wish you could take back. <short pause> Perhaps you spoke a word you regret. Perhaps you lost patience. <short pause> Perhaps you failed to love as you meant to love.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: It is easy, here in the quiet, to replay those moments. <short pause> To turn them over in your mind, examining each one... wondering what you should have done instead. <short pause> But tonight, you do not have to carry that weight. <short pause> Breathe in. <short pause> And breathe out... releasing the grip of guilt.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: God does not ask you to lie awake rehearsing your failures. <short pause> He invites you to bring them to him... and leave them there. <short pause> When you confess what is true, he does not turn away. <short pause> He forgives. <short pause> And when God forgives, he does not keep a record. <short pause> He does not hold your sin at arm's length, ready to bring it back when you stumble again. <short pause> He removes it.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Breathe in deeply. <short pause> And out, slowly. <short pause> Scripture tells us just how far he removes it.
As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us. <short pause> Psalm one hundred three, verse twelve. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The east and the west are not two points on a map that might one day meet. <short pause> They stretch on forever... never touching. <short pause> That is the distance God places between you and your sin, when he forgives you. <short pause> Infinite separation. <short pause> Complete removal.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You cannot travel far enough to find what he has taken away. <short pause> So tonight, you do not need to search for it either. <short pause> You do not need to dig up what he has buried. <short pause> You do not need to remember what he has chosen to forget. <short pause> Let your breathing slow even more now. <short pause> In... and out.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You are forgiven. <short pause> Not because you have earned it... but because God is merciful. <short pause> Not because your sin was small... but because his love is great. <short pause> And you are free.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Free from the burden of carrying what he has already carried for you. <short pause> Free from the voice that says you must prove yourself worthy. <short pause> Free to rest in the truth that you are his... and he does not let go.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Feel your body grow heavy... peaceful... still. <short pause> There is nothing left to fix tonight. <short pause> Nothing left to solve, or carry, or defend. <short pause> Breathe in. <short pause> And out.

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: You are loved... forgiven... and free. <short pause> And now... you may sleep.
